mainEntity.name: How long does a Jaguar E-Pace engine rebuild take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timescales depend on the fault, parts availability and machining required. We will give you an estimated timeframe once the engine has been assessed.

mainEntity.name: What is the Jaguar E-Pace engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost varies with the engine type, its condition and the parts needed. We provide a quote after inspection rather than a fixed price.

mainEntity.name: Do you supply a Jaguar E-Pace reconditioned engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Where replacement makes more sense than repair, we can supply and fit a reconditioned engine matched to your E-Pace engine code.

mainEntity.name: Do you work on E-Pace P250 and P300 petrol engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work on both Ingenium diesel and petrol E-Pace engines, including rebuild, repair and replacement for P250 and P300 models.

mainEntity.name: Can you replace the timing chain on an E-Pace?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Timing chain replacement is offered as a separate service. We inspect related components too, so any linked wear can be identified.

mainEntity.name: I'm not local. Can you still repair my E-Pace?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We are based in Essex and offer UK-wide collection and delivery, making us a practical option wherever your E-Pace is located.

mainEntity.name: How do I find my E-Pace engine code?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your engine code may appear in your vehicle documents or on the engine itself. Our team can help confirm it using your registration.
